periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted inward towards the muzzle at approximately a 45-degree angle from the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated vertical oval with a height significantly exceeding the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the lowest margin extending further from the geometric center than the top margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying approximately one-third of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation between the ears located at the upper lateral margins of the head.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Top boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a slightly flattened, non-spherical contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown staining of the fur on the muzzle and neck compared to the white fur on the forehead.
